f5_input_fix.reason: The row's text says he fouled the changeup straight back, but the input only said 'foul', so the read never reached the engine and the row could not pass. The fourth element is the read.

changes.label_review_note: 32 rows fail on the Acceptable share alone; none of their labels contradicts a decision on record, so no label was changed. The shared cause is middle being Arguable while the engine calls it 54.8% of the time (callsheet band B6), which Phase 3 fixes.

tracked.F6: Wants more fastballs because the hitter is late on them. The size of that effect is timing_B in the hitter model, which this plan may not touch; band T1 tracks the same thing.
tracked.F7: Wants soft stuff because the hitter is out in front of it. Same timing_B term as F6.
tracked.H4: Wants inside fastballs to a hitter who crowds the plate. The crowding term is hitter math; band T2 tracks the same effect and is also tracked.
